declined.no-conditional-spread: Foldkit views build child lists with `...(cond ? [x] : [])`.
declined.no-manual-tagged-construction: Flags aggregate state literals such as `{ _tag: "Unplaced" }` and test fixtures.
declined.no-manual-tagged-type: Flags `Extract<Union, { _tag: "X" }>` narrowing, not just hand-declared tags.
declined.require-readable-spacing: oxfmt owns layout; the rule autofixes ~950 blank lines of taste.
